args.sql: SELECT * FROM planet_instrument_observations LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM instruments_surveys;

-- First, let's see how many K2 observations exist and which planets they link to
SELECT poi.facilitylink, COUNT(*) 
FROM planet_instrument_observations poi 
JOIN instruments_surveys ins ON poi.facilitylink = ins.instrumentref 
WHERE ins.facilityname = 'k2'
GROUP BY poi.facilitylink;

-- Check sample of orbital characteristics and physical properties
SELECT oc.orbitalref, oc.bodylink, oc.period, oc.semimajor, pp.physref, pp.objectlink, pp.massjup 
FROM orbital_characteristics oc 
JOIN physical_properties pp ON oc.bodylink = pp.objectlink 
LIMIT 5;

-- Test the join to get K2-observed gas giant planets with their data
SELECT DISTINCT p.planetref, 
       s.stellarref,
       s.hostplname as star_name,
       s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value' as star_temp,
       s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' as star_radius,
       oc.semimajor,
       pp.massjup
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref
JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON p.planetref = oc.bodylink
JOIN physical_properties pp ON p.planetref = pp.objectlink
JOIN planet_instrument_observations poi ON p.planetref = poi.subjectlink
JOIN instruments_surveys ins ON poi.facilitylink = ins.instrumentref
WHERE ins.facilityname = 'k2'
  AND pp.massjup > 0.1
LIMIT 10;

-- Check how many have valid star_radius and semimajor
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value') as has_radius,
  COUNT(oc.semimajor) as has_semimajor
FROM planets p
JOIN stars s ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref
JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON p.planetref = oc.bodylink
JOIN physical_properties pp ON p.planetref = pp.objectlink
JOIN planet_instrument_observations poi ON p.planetref = poi.subjectlink
JOIN instruments_surveys ins ON poi.facilitylink = ins.instrumentref
WHERE ins.facilityname = 'k2'
  AND pp.massjup > 0.1;

-- Calculate equilibrium temperature for K2 gas giant planets
-- T_eq = T_star * sqrt(R_star / (2 * a))
SELECT AVG(
    CAST(s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value' AS numeric) * 
    SQRT(CAST(s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' AS numeric) / (2 * oc.semimajor))
) as avg_temp_kelvin
FROM planets p

JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON p.planetref = oc.bodylink
JOIN physical_properties pp ON p.planetref = pp.objectlink
JOIN planet_instrument_observations poi ON p.planetref = poi.subjectlink
JOIN instruments_surveys ins ON poi.facilitylink = ins.instrumentref
WHERE ins.facilityname = 'k2'

  AND s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' IS NOT NULL
  AND s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' != 'None'
